sources.title: Virmire Assignments
facts: Wrex can be persuaded through the recovered family armor or original Charm/Intimidate investments; the guide specifies 8 points to view every persuasion outcome. These talents are not implemented by the Resolve Virmire module.
Communications disruption, satellite destruction and refueling flyer destruction are separate optional objectives.
The security console offers an independent choice to disable alarms or redirect enemy attention towards the STG.
The guide attributes Kirrahe’s death to the alarm choice. This conflicts with the commonly reported flyer survival rule; the implementation deliberately exports unknown survival.

sources.title: Objective 1: Visit Virmire; Reach the Camp
facts: Kirrahe explains the krogan breeding facility and proposes detonating a makeshift nuclear device built from his ship’s drive core.
The STG makes a diversion while Shepard infiltrates and neutralizes antiaircraft defenses so the Normandy can deploy the device.
Ashley or Kaidan must lead one of the STG teams.

sources.title: Objective 2: Infiltrate Saren’s Base
facts: The communications tower and satellite link are distinct targets.

The refueling platform contains two rocket drones and three assault drones; fuel tanks can destroy them. The prototype represents this through a targeted terrain interaction, not five newly animated ATB enemies.

sources.title: Objective 3: Disable the AA Tower
facts: Rana studies indoctrination and identifies Sovereign as the source; Shepard can release or kill her, then access the private laboratory.
Shepard activates a second Prothean beacon before Sovereign’s holographic communication.
Sovereign reveals itself as a Reaper and claims responsibility for the Citadel and relay network, which shape the development of organic civilizations.

sources.title: Objective 4: Set the Nuke; Flee Virmire
facts: The STG volunteer is at the AA tower; the other human squad member remains to arm the bomb.
The bomb is armed under geth pressure before the definitive rescue choice.
Shepard chooses one of the two positions before confronting Saren and escaping; the crewmate not rescued dies.
